{{Top|leg}}
'''Six-wheeled trams''' were used by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shintel]] to transport personnel between the landing field and main structures of [[Imperial Depot 4290-1]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Heget]] used three six-wheeled trams to transport his [[Senior officer/Legends|senior officers]] and the command crew of the ''[[FarStar]]'' from the landing field to a meeting hall.
